reviews.comment: Most of the reviews are quite inaccurate. This class is no blow-off but if you pay attention in all the lectures and are not a moron then you'll do just fine. The test are pretty easy with the provided cheat-sheet. HWs are not that bad if you go to TA's OH. He does go over time in lecture. This class can be intimidating but really isn't that bad.

He's one of the best professor for this course. He goes deep into the concepts necessary for a grad level course. Extra credits were available. The whole course was very well organized. He clarified the expectations in the syllabus, uploaded detailed solutions, practice exams, lecture notes etc., which made things easier. I'd take his class again.

After the first week, either the class was cut in half, whether it was people dropping or people skipping class. Showing up to class is useless with this guy. Horrible teacher... no one has any idea what is going on. Maybe the book would help but the book makes 0 sense. DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY. If I could rate in negative numbers I definitely would.

I've had bad professors, but this one pops off as one of the worst I've ever had. You cannot see what he is writing on the whiteboard, and if you can see you cannot understand what he is writing. He has a thick accent and expects everyone to be an expert. His class is extremely hard, and no one knows what is going on. DO NOT Take.

I hated this class. This was the worst prof Ive ever had. Legit sucked my soul out. Doesnt prepare you well for tests. Homework is awful. He also has no respect for your time. He repeats himself lots and lots and you expect it to make more sense each time but NOPE it just gets more confusing. Please run.

I tend to disagree with the other reviews here. Statistics is meant to be understood from both an applied AND theoretical perspective, and Chakrabortty is able to provide that. Homework takes a long time and he makes you work hard, but you will have a much more fundamental understanding of the concepts if you take him.

Terrible professor. Well rounded in statistics, but cannot teach. Do not come into this class without knowing how to use R or you will fail. It's required for hws and he uses it in class- but its not allowed on exams. No one ever knows whats happening, he holds us 20 min after class, and all learning you will have to learn on your own. 10/10 DONT

Where do I start? My tutor for this class thought I was messing with her when I showed her my homework. She is a Master's in Statistics student and she said the proofs were just as difficult as hers. He consistently goes 20 minutes over in every lecture. Its a 3 hour class but you have to go to "optional" recitations or you wont pass. DONT TAKE!!!!

Dr. Chakrabortty is very smart, but he's one of those professors who cares about their subject too much and makes it much more difficult and confusing than it needs to be. He goes into way too much depth during lectures to the point where it's no longer beneficial. He doesn't prepare you well for the homework or the tests. Take Dr. Hart instead.

I used to love stats and now I do not. This class was extremely difficult. There were no practice problems to help understand the topic, the proofs were ridiculous, and he did not respect our time as we were constantly held over.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Chakrabortty definitely knows statistics very well, but is very inconsiderate. When courses were switched to online due to COVID-19; he made optional recitations, another lecture section and did not cover any of that material in actual lecture. He also consistently went at very least 20 mins over when class ended; would not recommend him
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy
